question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd9cfb10e21036ec7798c718f55e61c6ef9337a0a992d6617867329bf035e46e.png]
solution:
When a mirror is placed horizontally to the object, the image so formed will change their top and bottom

The upside and downside will interchange their position, while top left and right remain same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24989b1f231b1d47f00ac673e3590957b9be522ee40af3c52909583c1a9eba39.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **option(2) **
